invariants.text: Task.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
A task's status must be one of 'pending', 'in-progress', 'completed', or 'cancelled'.
A task's priority must be one of 'low', 'medium', 'high', or 'urgent'.
The due_date of a task must be a valid date in the past or in the future.
When a task is imported from JSON, all fields must match the expected schema and data types.
If a task's due_date is in the past, its status must be 'completed' or 'cancelled'.
Importing tasks from JSON must validate that each task has a title, description, status, and priority.
Exporting tasks to JSON must include all fields: title, description, status, priority, due_date, created_at, and updated_at.
A task's status cannot be changed to 'completed' if its due_date is in the future and the priority is 'low'.
When a task is created, its status must default to 'pending'.
The created_at field of a task must be set to the current timestamp when the task is created.
